_comment: Release-change lane (query.release_diff). annotation_lines: document bookkeeping the parser leaves inside a requirement's body. scope 'line' (default) matches a whole line, anchored and case-insensitive; scope 'inline' removes the matched fragment from within a line. A pair whose texts are equal once these are removed is one note per plan, not model input; the fragments also leave the text the model sees. model: pin the lane to one model regardless of the Ask page's choice (empty = the page's).
